extension.summary: Sentence - ask for what you want, in a sentence.
extension.description: Finish a sentence with the remote to filter your library: "Tonight I'd like a film under 2 hours, funny, from the 90s, that I haven't seen." Every screen talks in full sentences. Built for the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v0.9.8 - The header sentence ends "or [more]": update or clean the library, see them another way, sort, filter, find (also Left/Right past the edge of any view); "as [a grid]" opens a view picker with previews; update / clean on the System menu.
